metadata.title: Bedrock Lambda GitHub PR Review App Architecture POA&M

poam-items.title: Add nonce and timestamp replay window hardening
poam-items.description: Add nonce and timestamp replay window hardening

risks.title: Webhook spoofing risk
risks.description: Forged webhook requests could trigger unauthorized review actions.
risks.statement: Signature verification is implemented; replay defenses are periodically revalidated.

risks.title: Review output secret leakage risk
risks.description: Findings publication may expose sensitive content if redaction and credential controls drift.
risks.statement: Current controls reduce exposure but need ongoing tuning for new secret formats.

risks.title: Prompt injection in PR context risk
risks.description: Prompt-like diff content can degrade policy-aligned review output quality.
risks.statement: Prompt hardening exists, but adversarial payload patterns evolve.
